description.value: Pilgrim Coffee is a café situated on Sooke Road in the western Victoria region, a corridor frequently travelled by cyclists heading toward Langford and Sooke. OSM records outdoor seating, making it a potential rest stop for riders on this busy commuter and touring route. Without accessible website content, the full scope of its offerings for cyclists remains unconfirmed.
